"Your requested slot " & Text(varStartTime, "HH:mm") & " - " & Text(varEndTime, "HH:mm") & " is unavailable"

    ThisItem.SlotStart >= varConflictingBooking.StartDateTime &&
    ThisItem.SlotEnd <= varConflictingBooking.EndDateTime,
    AppTheme.HeaderBackground,
    AppTheme.layer01Bg
)

If(
    ThisItem.SlotStart >= varConflictingBooking.StartDateTime &&
    ThisItem.SlotStart < varConflictingBooking.EndDateTime,
    If(
        ThisItem.SlotStart = varConflictingBooking.StartDateTime,
        varConflictingBooking.Title & " - " & varConflictingBooking.BookedBy.DisplayName,
        ""
    ),
    If(ThisItem.SlotStart = varNextFreeSlot, "Next free slot", "Free")
)

If(
    ThisItem.SlotStart >= varConflictingBooking.StartDateTime &&
    ThisItem.SlotEnd <= varConflictingBooking.EndDateTime,
    ColorValue(AppTheme.PrimaryText),
    If(ThisItem.SlotStart = varNextFreeSlot, RGBA(66, 190, 101, 1), AppTheme.TextSecondary)
)

Concurrent(
    Set(varSelectedRoom, ThisItem),
    Set(varConflict, false),
    Set(varStep, 3)
)
